title: Usage cache
description: usage-last.json (data folder root): the plan usage check's saved state, shared by the Bun daemon and the Rust front server. Type Saved in src/usage/usage-cache.ts (UsageAnswer and UsageWindow in src/usage/usage.ts). Written by UsageCache.save after every check (compact JSON, no final newline, atomicWrite); read at start and again when its size or mtime changes. Times attemptAt, blockedUntil and lastError.at are epoch ms (0: never). The reader takes a missing or non-number time as 0, caps attemptAt at now and blockedUntil at now + 30 min. Unknown fields must be kept.

last.description: The last good answer, kept through later errors; null when there never was one.

lastError.description: The latest failed check, cleared by a good one; null when the last check succeeded.

attemptAt.description: When the last check started (epoch ms).

blockedUntil.description: No check before this (epoch ms; backing off after a 429). 0: not blocked.

failures.description: 429 answers in a row; reset by a good answer or another error.

key.description: The endpoint's window key, e.g. five_hour, seven_day, seven_day_opus.

limited.description: The answer was a 429 (Anthropic rate limit).
